# FirstLight runtime subset

Source: https://github.com/Jaasssoooonnnnn/FirstLight_CR

Revision: `3ade158c52bf33de3ffcea600ce380946b7de0d8`

This directory contains the unchanged Python modules reached by checkpoint
loading and inference, plus the compiled competitive card/semantic data used
by those modules. The original `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` are included. It does
not include checkpoints, training datasets, replay histories, executables,
game assets, or the author's full offline battle-engine checkout.
